description: Fix all backend correctness issues identified in Phase 2 of master prompt (items 14-29): transactional safety, race conditions, atomic operations, security vulnerabilities. These are critical correctness bugs that affect data integrity, concurrency safety, and security. All fixes must be implemented in web backend services (lib/services/*, modules/*/services/*) as mobile is a client that calls these services. Mobile changes are only needed where mobile duplicates logic it should delegate to server.
steps: VAULT QUOTA (item 14): Read lib/services/QuotaService.ts and Vault upload logic. Fix race condition: quota check and document insert must be in single transaction. Current: check quota → insert document (race window). Fixed: SELECT count + INSERT in single transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE or advisory lock.

SYNC LAST_SYNCED_AT (item 15): Read sync timestamp logic in lib/sync/* or mobile sync. Server time must be authoritative. Client never invents timestamps. Change: server returns lastSyncedAt in sync response, client stores it verbatim.
SYNC VERSION-AWARE (item 16): Read sync conflict resolution. If incoming.version <= local.version, ignore (already applied). Else apply update. Implement version comparison in sync engine.

SYNC RESTORED_LOGS (item 17): Read sync restoration logic. When entity is restored (deletedAt set to null), sync must apply restoration as transaction: update entity.deletedAt = null, create restoration audit log if auditable.

SYNC BOUNDED_PAGES (item 18): Read sync pagination. Never load unlimited history. Implement page size limit (e.g. 100 records per page), transactional page processing (all records in page succeed or all rollback).

WORK_SESSION CONCURRENCY (item 19): Read modules/work/services/WorkSessionService.ts. Enforce one active session per user. Current startSession has advisory lock but verify it's correct. Add database constraint if possible: UNIQUE INDEX ON (userId, status) WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED') AND deletedAt IS NULL. Verify mobile never creates session directly, always calls web API.

WORK_SESSION ATOMICITY (item 20): Verify WorkSessionService.startSession creates WorkSession + ActivityLog in single transaction. Already implemented, verify mobile respects it (never creates separate log).

LOG_WORK_PRESENCE (item 21): Read app/actions/log.ts logWorkPresence. One canonical service, WorkSessionService. Mobile must never create work logs directly, always call logWorkPresence or startSession API.

POSTPONE SCOPE (item 22): Read postpone logic in ActivityService or CompletionService. Postpone must only affect target task ActivityLog, never other tasks or unrelated logs. Verify: postpone by templateId + date updates only that specific log, creates new log for next day if needed.

LEAVE OVERLAP (item 23): Read LeaveRecord validation. Prevent overlapping leave under concurrency. Use database exclusion constraint or advisory lock: before insert, SELECT existing leaves for user WHERE daterange overlaps, FOR UPDATE, then validate no overlap.
LEAVE BATCH (item 24): Read batch leave creation (if exists). validate + reserve allowance + create all records in single transaction. Rollback if any validation fails.
LINK OPEN_COUNT (item 25): Read SavedLink openCount increment. Use atomic SQL: UPDATE saved_links SET openCount = openCount + 1 WHERE id = ?. Never read-increment-write (race condition).

ADMIN SECURITY (item 26): Read lib/services/AdminService.ts. API key verification must be constant-time to prevent timing attacks. Use crypto.timingSafeEqual or equivalent. Implement rate limiting on admin endpoints.

AUTH REAUTHENTICATION (item 27): Identify sensitive operations (delete account, change email, change password, billing changes). Require recent authentication (session age < 5 minutes) or explicit password re-entry.
AUTH TURNSTILE (item 28): Read Turnstile integration (if exists). Turnstile token must be bound to specific attempt (login, signup), consumed once, validated server-side, expire after short time.

PASSWORD RESET (item 29): Read PasswordResetToken model and reset flow. Token must be hashed in database (store hash, not plaintext), expire after 1 hour, consumed once (delete on use), validated with constant-time comparison.
Mobile delegation verification: For each item, verify mobile does NOT duplicate the logic. Mobile must call web API. If mobile has local business rule it shouldn't, remove it and delegate to server.
acceptance_criteria: Vault quota: concurrent uploads do not exceed quota (tested with parallel requests)
Sync timestamps: server authoritative, client never sets lastSyncedAt
Sync version: version conflicts resolved correctly (older version ignored)
Sync restoration: restored entities sync correctly, deletedAt = null propagates
Sync pagination: sync processes bounded pages (100 records max per page), no memory overflow on large history
WorkSession concurrency: only one active session per user (database constraint enforced), concurrent start requests idempotent
WorkSession atomicity: WorkSession + ActivityLog created atomically (both or neither)
logWorkPresence: single canonical service, mobile never creates work logs directly
Postpone: only target task affected, no side effects on other logs
Leave overlap: overlapping leave prevented under concurrency
Link openCount: atomic increment, no lost updates
Admin security: constant-time API key verification, rate limiting active
Auth reauthentication: sensitive operations require recent auth
Turnstile: token bound to attempt, single use
Password reset: token hashed, expires, single use
Mobile: calls web API for all business logic, no local duplication
verification: bun test tests/ lib/services/ (all tests pass)
Concurrency test: parallel Vault uploads, verify quota not exceeded
Concurrency test: parallel WorkSession starts, verify only one active
Concurrency test: parallel leave creates with overlap, verify all but one rejected
Security test: admin endpoint rate limiting (attempt 100 requests in 1 second, verify rate limit)
Security test: password reset token timing (verify constant-time comparison)
Mobile verification: grep m/src for business logic that should be server-side, ensure mobile calls API
